fields.why: The Figure's test for trend across single age bins (50–54 to 70–75) and Table 1's screening percentages across education, income and six race/ethnicity groups are outcomes measured in 3 or more SPD groups.
Sex, insurance, provider status and metro residence are pairs; education (4), income (5) and race/ethnicity (6) are shown per group, and age enters through the trend test.

The chi-square tests compare 50–64 vs 65–75 years within each level (an age pair, not a test across education, income or race; rule F6), so the mechanical flag is a false alarm for the SES and race entries; the trend test applies only to age.
